description: arXiv:2607.04814v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Extending automatic speech recognition (ASR) to low-resource African languages is constrained by the prohibitive demands of data collection at scale. A promising direction is to leverage the linguistic relatedness between a low-resource target language and languages previously seen by a model to reduce the volume of target-language data...
